[user]: I run docuctl 2.x. How do I roll production back to r41?
[docs_helper]: In docuctl 2.x, run:

```bash
docuctl rollback --env production --to r41
```

This points traffic to `r41` without rebuilding and records the rollback as a new release. Note that database migrations are not automatically rolled back.

[user]: And on staging?
[docs_helper]: To roll staging back to `r41`, specify `--env staging`:

```bash
docuctl rollback --env staging --to r41
```

If you just want to roll back to the previous release on staging, omit `--to`:

```bash
docuctl rollback --env staging
```
